note: Every dispatch of the v5 grid on the max since the engine was re-declared on 13 October at night (omni-v5, digest 6093b2b88aa911b9: every muscle from 1 up to one click under its own capacity, read live, in the live controllers; the modelled organisms as on the card version), by grid, size and run range. 'kept' runs count toward their squares; 'cancelled' runs count toward nothing. Dispatches are named by their squares (run-name) and found by scripts/dispatch_grid.py itself, counted from the time in its SINCE. With the cluster inside only runs of protocol 3 count (the model of the organism on its own core, the window set from the heavier arm's measured step). The grid is 1, 10 and 100 only (the founder's order of 12 October). The grids of the engines before (digests 8d4f91f0, 9be48445 and 5648f290, the card version, whose page stands in results/grid_v5/GRID.md until this grid replaces it) count in no square of this one; history/ keeps their records.
